text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Fuji Kiseki runs into Curren
Chan by
chance while she's out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence meeting you here,
Curren.
What are you up to?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm here filming a lil' something for

Umastagram! ☆ Everyone's been raving
about the
desserts at this place.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You're on Umastagram too, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we do this together, then?
Your trainer
can join us too, of course! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, sounds like a plan. I can't wait to
try the
food. Everything on the menu
looks gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay! ♪ C'mon, let's get a selfie together
real
quick!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flash!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gooosh... Fuji, you are just too

awesome! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I mean this! Look, you've angled yourself

perfectly to the light and your smile is
spot-on!
You've even flawlessly matched
your energy to
mine!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Don't think I don't notice and
appreciate
the comments you leave on
my posts, @Curren.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's Umastagram account,

@DREAM_MAKER, is filled with
carefully curated
pictures that look like
they're straight out of a
whimsical fairy
tale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I secretly follow her, so I know exactly
why her
account is so wildly
popular—her photos really
seem to draw
one into a land of dreams.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, why don't you have an
account on
Umatter yet?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure your fans would love to see the
"real" you
in a more casual, day-to-day
setting! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Do you wish to see who I am? Strip me
of my
costumes and masks, wrench me
from the stage,
and there I shall be, the
truest form of myself."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"But I cannot bare myself to you. Nay, I
mustn't!
My true self must be hidden,
lest its cloying
sweetness forever trap
you in a waking dream."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"And if such tragedy were to occur... My
love, I
would never be able to bring
myself to set you
free..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flash!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow... That was a good shot.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That was really dramatic... But don't you
think
you were laying it on a bit thick?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I always give what my audience wants,
but I would
never choose to destroy the
illusion and wake
them from their dream.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is one thing I'll never do, no matter
how
much they want it. I have my pride
as an
entertainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fuji...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Umatter is such a casual
platform, I'm
afraid I'll accidentally
break character while
posting on it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm but an inexperienced student, and I
must take
care not to get carried away
and ruin my image!
Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If you say so. But you've given
me some
food for thought! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way back, Fuji Kiseki starts some
small
talk with me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: By the way, do you use social media?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So you do use it! Could it be you also follow me on Umastagram?
choice_data_list: 記録のためのブログなら……
choice_data_list_en: I think I'm more of a spectator.
If it's a blog just for keeping records...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Really? I had no idea!
choice_data_list: 実はフォロー済みなんだ

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What interesting information indeed! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I forget all about our conversation, but a
few
days later...

text_block_list.name: @Dreamer4385
text_block_list.text:
OMG! I literally CAN'T with Fuji's post
today!

text_block_list.name: @PrisonerSheep21
text_block_list.text: Nooo! I want to hold her hand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki has posted an absolutely
breathtaking
photo that seems to
scream, "Come, take my
hand." The stats
on the picture are downright
scary.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you run a blog? What are you
keeping a
record of?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her how I collate all the things I've
learned
and noticed, and use it as a kind
of record book.
choice_data_list: トレーニングについての、かな

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Would it be all right if I looked through
it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My blog isn't the most exciting thing in
the world,
so I'm a bit embarrassed to
show her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wow... I had no idea you were so...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nothing, never mind. I just feel even
more
motivated to live up to your
expectations now,
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right! Let's hurry back so we can rest up
for
tomorrow's training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She lets out a clear, ringing laugh, and
we
continue heading home.
